subject.title: [Feature]: Make mobile node setup full-access by default

question: Should official native iOS and Android setup codes mint the fixed full native operator profile by default instead of the current bounded profile?
rationale: The request intentionally reverses a recently hardened least-privilege default and changes what authority possession of a mobile setup code grants, so the permanent boundary requires explicit owner approval.

options.title: Full native default
options.body: Grant the fixed server-defined full native operator profile for official mobile bootstrap while preserving an explicit limited-access setup choice.

options.title: Bounded default with upgrade
options.body: Keep the current bounded bootstrap profile and add a prominent in-product full-access upgrade and reconnect flow.

recommendation.title: Full native default
recommendation.body: Grant the fixed server-defined full native operator profile for official mobile bootstrap while preserving an explicit limited-access setup choice.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current bounded policy and is the assigned sponsor of the proposed direction change.
